name: BBEE Inspector (developer tool)
author: BBEE modding project
description: Live in-battle inspector: current action and timing, every input press and why it was or wasn't used, skill-chain cancel windows and lockouts, hits given and taken, effect spawn/attachment/cleanup, warnings. F8 overlay, F9 export a diagnostic report to <workspace>/diag, F10 pause, F11 frame step, F7 simulation speed, F6 effect filter. Read-only except pause/speed. See docs/tools/INSPECTOR.md.
